reviews.text:
This ceramide cream has been a great match for my dry skin, especially while using tretinoin. It provides strong moisture without feeling greasy and absorbs faster than expected for a richer formula.

The texture strikes a good balance—not too heavy, yet not too light—and leaves the skin feeling plump and well hydrated. It wears comfortably throughout the day and sits nicely under makeup without disrupting application. I also really appreciate the packaging, which feels practical and well designed.

Overall, it performs exactly as needed for dry skin that requires extra support. I would gladly repurchase and would recommend it to anyone looking for a dependable, moisturizing ceramide cream.
reviews.zh:
呢款神經醯胺面霜好啱我嘅乾性皮膚，特別係我用緊 tretinoin 嗰陣。補濕力好強，但唔會油膩，而且吸收比想像中快，一款咁豐富嘅配方都吸收得咁快。

質地平衡得好好，唔會太厚，亦唔會太薄，令皮膚感覺飽滿、補足水分。全日用著都好舒服，喺化妝底下好服貼，唔會影響上妝。我亦好欣賞包裝，睇落實用又設計得好。

整體嚟講，對需要額外支援嘅乾性皮膚，佢表現正正係我需要嘅。我會再買，亦會推薦俾想搵可靠、滋潤神經醯胺面霜嘅人。

reviews.text: As a person with very dry skin that also use tretinoin, I really enjoy thick ceramide creams. This one is a very moisturizing cream that absorbs quickly without feeling greasy. It is not too heavy and not too light eight. I love the packaging. It really works perfect on dry skin leaving it plump and hydrated. It sits well under makeup too. I will definitely buy this again. Highly recommend it!!!!!
reviews.zh: 我嘅皮膚好乾，又有用 tretinoin，所以我好鍾意厚身嘅神經醯胺面霜。呢款好滋潤，吸收快，又唔油膩。唔會太厚，亦唔會太薄。我好鍾意包裝。用喺乾性皮膚上真係好啱，令皮膚飽滿又補足水分。喺化妝底下都好服貼。我一定會再買，非常推薦！！！！！

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
